models.name: 6drepnet360

params.input: crop 'fsa' (detector crop behind the published 6DRepNet/6DRepNet360 BIWI results: FSA-Net TYY_create_db_biwi.py with image size 256): detector box + 0.4*w / 0.4*h each side, clipped, squashed to 256x256 (cv2 bilinear), RGB, Resize(256) + CenterCrop(224) (test.py), ImageNet mean/std; 6DRepNet360 has no inference/demo code, so this is its only official detector-box pipeline; output rotation matrix -> Euler (6DRepNet utils) -> §0 yaw, pitch, roll (upstream yaw negated)
params.paper: Hempel et al., Toward Robust and Unconstrained Full Range of Rotation Head Pose Estimation, IEEE TIP 33:2377-2387, 2024

models.source: https://huggingface.co/minchul/cvlface_adaface_ir101_webface12m (revision 54f602a0737bd1ee4a4e7e9fd089a485f397fefd) model.safetensors (260,980,552 B; sha256 equals the HF LFS oid). The repo's pretrained_model/model.pt (pickle, LFS sha256 e312d792...) was not downloaded.

models.name: farl_wflw_448

params.backbone: FaRL ViT-B/16 (LAION-Face20M), FPN from blocks 3/5/7/11; head mmseg UPerHead (TorchScript)
params.box_crop: square side max(w,h) centred on box -> 0.8*448 px (FaRL WFLW protocol, HRNet center/scale box)
params.decode: soft-argmax over the 112x112 sigmoid heatmap (FaRL heatmap2points) -> crop px -> inverse affine
params.kps_crop: similarity (least squares) of 5 kps onto facer standard points ([[196,226],[316,226],[256,286],[220,360.4],[292,360.4]]/256-1)*0.8, mapped to [0,447]
